placements.title: Organizational authority over what knowledge is retained or erased
placements.frame: What knowledge does the organization direct to be kept, removed, or controlled, and through what mechanisms?

placements.title: Knowledge removal performed as flat operational housekeeping
placements.frame: How is the erasure of knowledge commanded when it is issued not as a dramatic event but as routine administrative clearing?
placements.why: Both segments command knowledge removal in a low-arousal, matter-of-fact register — 'Forget everything about' and 'Remove all knowledge of' — performing erasure as settled operational instruction rather than argued or urgent action. The directional reads converge on calm-negative affect, formal-to-matter-of-fact register, and decision-level conviction: this is a theme about how knowledge erasure is performed as routine housekeeping, a subject future envelopes may continue to feed.
